explication: AgOpenGPS is agricultural guidance and precision-mapping software, accompanied by AgIO, its communications hub. The main user workflow is to start the GPS application, receive position data, work with field geometry and guidance tracks, and produce steering guidance and section control. The repository also includes field sharing, configuration and rendering, plus a separate updater. The README documents product capabilities; sampled source and the SOURCE INDEX support only selected internal links, so unsampled subsystem connections are not inferred.
